name: Pinecone
shortDescription: Managed vector database. Starter is free, and Builder is $20 per month.
longDescription: Pinecone is a managed vector database used in retrieval stacks. On October 16, 2026 the pricing page listed Starter as free and Builder at $20 per month. We did not create an account.
pricingNotes: Confirm Starter vs free on pinecone.io/pricing.
bestFor: Hosted vector search inside a RAG stack
Teams that do not want to run the database themselves
notIdealFor: Web search or page crawling — different tools
strength: Starter is free for hosted vector search, and Builder is $20 per month with a 3-week trial.
weakness: Builder is $20 per month after the trial, and the free Starter limits were not spelled out on the page we parsed.
smokeTestNotes: No local install attempted (SaaS/desktop/extension or install not feasible without account).

useCaseFit.research-rag: Hosts vectors for search over your documents, with a free Starter plan.
